structured_claims.overall_summary: Meta reported Q1 revenue of $42.3 billion, up 16% year over year, and operating income of $17.6 billion at a 41% margin. Reality Labs reported a $4.2 billion operating loss; Meta also described increased planned investment to bring capacity online sooner. For business context, the earlier Q4 call reported Rest of World ad-revenue growth of 27% versus Q1’s 19%, and a Reality Labs operating loss of $5.0 billion versus Q1’s $4.2 billion. These company-level comparisons do not establish a change in any executive’s communication. FinBERT classified 26.1% of scored transcript segments as positive, 3.2% as negative and 70.7% as neutral.
